data.title: Head Chef
data.summary: Lead a small kitchen team preparing restaurant lunches and catering. The role also involves developing the lunch offering and catering business.

requirements.text: At least 3 years as a head chef or shift manager in Finland
requirements.question: Would someone who has done head chef or shift manager work, with fewer than 3 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting requires prior head chef or shift manager experience gained over a set period in Finland.

requirements.text: Ability to independently lead a kitchen and a small team

requirements.question: What does 'passion for hands-on kitchen work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises passion for kitchen work and being actively involved rather than working at a laptop.

requirements.text: Developmental leadership and ability to inspire the team
requirements.question: What does 'developmental leadership' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting describes developmental leadership and inspiring others as strengths without giving a concrete example.

requirements.text: Broad professional expertise for business and team development
